rules.text: Davco® K10 Plus is a premium performance, flexible, premixed, ready to use, water based polyurethane Class III waterproofing membrane designed for use under tile and stone and other resilient finishes.
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: Davco® K10 Plus is suitable for interior and exterior applications
rules.heading: USES

rules.text: Suitable as an anti fracture membrane
rules.heading: CHARACTERISTICS / ADVANTAGES

rules.text: Do not apply in temperatures above 35°C or below 5°C
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Do not use in areas of permanent immersion such as swimming pools or ponds etc
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Do not use where negative hydrostatic pressure is evident (rising damp), as if affects the bond of Davco® K10 Plus
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Prime metal surface with a suitable etching primer
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY

rules.text: Building Boards and Sheeting Standard wall / floor building boards must be primed with a suitable Sika Branded primer and firmly fixed in accordance to manufacturer instructions and applicable Australian Standards
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY

rules.text: For balconies and rooftops, the slope of this fall should be 1:100 – which equates to a 10mm fall over 1m
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY

rules.text: Surfaces that are to receive Davco® K10 Plus shall be primed with a suitable Sika primer prior to the waterproofing membrane application
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY / PRE-TREATMENT
